code:
bun test --isolate ./tests
bun test --parallel ./tests
bun test --parallel=8 ./tests
purpose: Run each test file in a fresh global environment (--isolate) or distribute across N worker processes (--parallel).
notes: Available in bun test. Could adopt --parallel for CI to speed up 2451 tests.

code:
bun test --shard=1/3
bun test --shard=2/3
bun test --shard=3/3
purpose: Split test files across multiple CI runners. Round-robin distribution, 1-based index.
notes: Could adopt for CI parallelization. Composes with --changed and --randomize.

code:
bun test --changed
bun test --changed=HEAD~1
bun test --changed --watch
purpose: Only run test files affected by git changes. Builds import graph, filters transitively.
notes: Could adopt for faster local dev iteration. Composes with --watch.
